title: Applied Mechanics
description: Statics and particle dynamics — statics of particles, equivalent force systems, rigid-body equilibrium, trusses, frames and machines, dry friction, centroids and moments of inertia, kinematics, Newton's second law, work-energy and impulse-momentum — written strictly from Beer, Johnston, Mazurek & Cornwell, Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics and Dynamics (10th ed.).
textbook: Beer, Johnston, Mazurek & Cornwell — Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics and Dynamics, 10th Edition

topics.ccmasRef: Forces as vectors; resolution and composition of forces; equilibrium of a particle

topics.ccmasRef: Friction on inclined planes, ladders, wedges, screws and belts

topics.ccmasRef: Centroids, first and second moments of area; moments of inertia

topics.ccmasRef: Kinematics of particles; projectiles; normal–tangential and radial–transverse components
